name: IKE
summary: Poland's individual retirement account. Withdrawals after age 60 are free of the 19% capital gains tax.

rules.name: Client is a Polish tax resident
rules.message: An IKE can only be held by a Polish tax resident. Client residency: {tax_residency}.
rules.explain: IKE is available to individuals resident in Poland (simplified).

rules.name: Client is at least 16
rules.message: The client must be at least 16 to open an IKE.
rules.explain: IKE accounts may be opened from age 16.

rules.name: One IKE per person
rules.message: This client already holds an IKE ({existing}).
rules.explain: Each person may hold one IKE.

rules.name: Annual contribution limit
rules.message: This deposit exceeds the IKE annual contribution limit.
rules.explain: Contributions are capped each year at 3× the projected average monthly salary (PLN 28,260 in this demo).

rules.name: Instrument is listed
rules.message: {symbol} isn't eligible for an IKE brokerage account.
rules.explain: A brokerage IKE can hold listed shares, ETFs and bonds.

rules.name: Sufficient cash in the account
rules.message: Not enough cash in the account. Required {required}, available {available}.
rules.explain: Purchases and withdrawals must be covered by cash held inside the wrapper.

schedule.label: Age 60+
schedule.note: Withdrawals from age 60 are free of capital-gains tax.

schedule.label: Before 60
schedule.note: Early withdrawal: 19% capital-gains tax on the gain and the account is closed.
